theme: 3 terms for SwiftUI containers: a settings form and two lazy layouts

terms.definition: A container that groups controls for a settings or input screen.
terms.example: Put the switches in a Form.

terms.definition: A vertical stack that creates its views only when they scroll into view.

video.title: Form, LazyVStack & LazyVGrid | Day 138
video.description:
Learn to explain SwiftUI containers for settings, feeds and photo grids: Form, LazyVStack & LazyVGrid, with real code, a quiz at the end and each example read twice (normal, then slow).

Today's terms
Form - A container that groups controls for a settings or input screen.
LazyVStack - A vertical stack that creates its views only when they scroll into view.
LazyVGrid - A grid that fills columns with views and creates them only when they scroll into view.

Quiz at the end - write your answers in the comments, then watch again to check.

landscape.description:
Explain Form, LazyVStack & LazyVGrid in SwiftUI by listening to a real code chat between two iOS devs.
폼, 레이지브이스택, 레이지브이그리드 표현을 영어 대화로 익혀요.

Form - A container that groups controls for a settings or input screen.
한국어: 폼: 설정이나 입력 화면을 위해 컨트롤을 묶는 컨테이너

한국어: 레이지브이그리드: 열에 뷰를 채우고 스크롤되어 들어올 때만 만드는 격자

landscape.hook: Can you explain Form, LazyVStack and LazyVGrid in English?

dialogue.title: Pick the container

lines.speaker: A
lines.text: Jake, I have a long screen of settings. Which container should I use?

lines.speaker: B
lines.text: Use a Form. It groups controls like switches and pickers in the standard settings style.

lines.speaker: A
lines.text: Good. Next is a feed with a thousand rows.

lines.speaker: B
lines.text: Use a LazyVStack inside a ScrollView.

lines.speaker: A
lines.text: Why Lazy? A normal VStack worked in my test.

lines.speaker: B
lines.text: A VStack builds every row at once. A LazyVStack builds a row only when it scrolls into view.

lines.speaker: A
lines.text: I see. And for photos in two columns?

lines.speaker: B
lines.text: Use a LazyVGrid with two `GridItem` values, like in the code.

lines.speaker: A
lines.text: I put a Form inside the LazyVGrid, and it looked strange.

lines.speaker: B
lines.text: A Form is for settings. For photos, put simple views in the LazyVGrid.

lines.speaker: A
lines.text: So the LazyVGrid is lazy like the LazyVStack?

lines.speaker: B
lines.text: Yes. Both create views only when they are needed, so scrolling stays smooth.
Put the settings controls in a Form.
